name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme with high-contrast interactive elements for EXCAVA’s interface. This maximizes visibility in low-light screencasts and aligns with Manus’ competitive analysis, where dark themes improve liveliness and clarity. The trade-off is reduced readability for users with light sensitivity, but we prioritize screencast quality and team consistency.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail users with light sensitivity—this isn’t a niche edge case. A toggle between dark and light modes costs nothing to implement and keeps visibility high for everyone. The argument settles when we test both with real screencast users and measure readability under glare.
